items.name: Stretch Cat Sampler
items.tip: Stretch Cat Sampler: a sampler instrument. Warp a loop, slice it, play slices from your keyboard, transpose over time.

items.name: Stretch Cat FX
items.tip: Stretch Cat FX: an effect. It grabs the last bars of your DAW audio and lets you stretch it, bend its pitch and perform tape stops, freezes and risers.

items.name: Source
items.tip: Sampler: the sample that gets warped. FX: the audio your DAW sends in.

items.name: Play
items.tip: Play the stretched result. Shortcut: Space.

items.name: Load file
items.tip: Load your own audio file (wav, mp3, flac, ogg). It stays in this browser tab and is never uploaded.

items.name: Host BPM
items.tip: The tempo your DAW runs at. Keep length stretches the loop to match it. Double-click resets.

items.name: MIDI root
items.tip: The key that plays the sample at its original pitch.

items.name: Source
items.tip: The whole sample. The bright part is the selection that gets stretched. Drag the orange handles; in the sampler drag the yellow slice marks.

items.name: C3·1
items.tip: Slice 1: press to hear it, with your stretch and pitch settings. Keys 1 to 8 do the same.

items.name: C3·2
items.tip: Slice 2: press to hear it, with your stretch and pitch settings. Keys 1 to 8 do the same.

items.name: C3·3
items.tip: Slice 3: press to hear it, with your stretch and pitch settings. Keys 1 to 8 do the same.

items.name: C3·4
items.tip: Slice 4: press to hear it, with your stretch and pitch settings. Keys 1 to 8 do the same.

items.name: C3·5
items.tip: Slice 5: press to hear it, with your stretch and pitch settings. Keys 1 to 8 do the same.

items.name: C3·6
items.tip: Slice 6: press to hear it, with your stretch and pitch settings. Keys 1 to 8 do the same.

items.name: C3·7
items.tip: Slice 7: press to hear it, with your stretch and pitch settings. Keys 1 to 8 do the same.

items.name: C3·8
items.tip: Slice 8: press to hear it, with your stretch and pitch settings. Keys 1 to 8 do the same.

items.name: BY TRANSIENT
items.tip: Place slice marks on the strongest hits in the selection.

items.name: EVEN
items.tip: Cut the selection into eight equal parts.

items.name: NORMALIZE
items.tip: Make the selection as loud as it can be without clipping (applies to the whole source).

items.name: REVERSE
items.tip: Play the selection backwards.

items.name: RESET
items.tip: Reload the original sample.

items.name: Result
items.tip: What the stretch engine made from the selection, with your pitch, speed and curves. The white line is the play position.

items.name: PITCH
items.tip: Transposition over the length of the selection. Drag the dots, click to add one, double-click to remove it.

items.name: SPEED
items.tip: Playback speed over time (with Keep pitch it only changes length, with Tape linked it changes pitch too).

items.name: CUTOFF
items.tip: Low-pass cutoff over time: close it to make a swell or a wash.

items.name: FORMANT
items.tip: Formant shift over time. Plugin only: it is drawn here but not audible in this mockup.

items.name: WIDTH
items.tip: Stereo width over time.

items.name: FLAT
items.tip: Reset this lane to a straight line.

items.name: Curve editor
items.tip: Draw what changes over the length of the selection: pitch, speed, cutoff, formant or width. Drag a dot, click empty space to add one, double-click a dot to remove it.

items.name: Stretch mode
items.tip: In the mockup each mode is a different grain setting. Beats: short grains for drums. Tones: long grains for sustained sounds. Texture: random grains for pads. Re-Pitch: tape speed. Complex and Formant+: all-rounders. The plugin will use dedicated algorithms.

items.name: Grain
items.tip: Grain size: smaller is tighter in time, larger is smoother. Double-click resets.

items.name: Transients
items.tip: How hard the engine searches for the best splice point. More keeps hits sharper. Double-click resets.

items.name: Smooth
items.tip: Length of the crossfade between grains. Double-click resets.

items.name: Transpose
items.tip: Pitch in semitones. Double-click resets.

items.name: Fine
items.tip: Pitch in cents. Double-click resets.

items.name: Speed
items.tip: Overall playback speed. 2 is twice as fast. Double-click resets.

items.name: Link
items.tip: Keep length: the loop is stretched to your host tempo. Keep pitch: speed changes only the length. Tape linked: speed and pitch move together, like a record.

items.name: Length
items.tip: Sets how long the stretched sample lasts, in note values or bars at the host tempo (4/4). The stretch fits the selection to that length, so the Speed knob is ignored while a length is chosen. Auto: the length follows Speed and Link.

items.name: Playback
items.tip: One-shot: plays once. Loop: repeats. Gate: plays while you hold Play. Slices to keys: keys 1 to 8 play the slices.

items.name: Attack
items.tip: Fade in. Double-click resets.

items.name: Release
items.tip: Fade out. Double-click resets.

items.name: Glide
items.tip: Time to slide between notes (plugin only: needs MIDI). Double-click resets.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turn the filter on or off.

items.name: Type
items.tip: Filter shape.

items.name: Cutoff
items.tip: Cutoff frequency. Double-click resets.

items.name: Reso
items.tip: Resonance. Double-click resets.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turn the EQ on or off.

items.name: Low
items.tip: Low shelf (200 Hz). Double-click resets.

items.name: Mid
items.tip: Mid band (1 kHz). Double-click resets.

items.name: High
items.tip: High shelf (5 kHz). Double-click resets.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turn the compressor on or off.

items.name: Thresh
items.tip: Level where compression starts. Double-click resets.

items.name: Ratio
items.tip: How hard it squeezes. Double-click resets.

items.name: Attack
items.tip: How fast it reacts. Double-click resets.

items.name: Release
items.tip: How fast it lets go. Double-click resets.

items.name: On
items.tip: Formant control. Plugin only: not audible in this mockup.

items.name: Shift
items.tip: Natural to chipmunk. Plugin only: not audible in this mockup. Double-click resets.

items.name: Keep
items.tip: Keep the formants where they were when you transpose. Plugin only.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turn the detune voices on or off. Takes effect the next time you press Play.

items.name: Detune
items.tip: Spread of the voices in cents. Double-click resets.

items.name: Voices
items.tip: How many copies. Double-click resets.

items.name: Width
items.tip: Haas widening: a delayed copy on the right. Double-click resets.

items.name: Haas
items.tip: Delay of the widening copy. Double-click resets.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turn the output stage on or off.

items.name: Limit
items.tip: Limiter on the output.

items.name: Mix
items.tip: Blend between the unprocessed stretch (left) and the whole rack (right). Double-click resets.

items.name: Gain
items.tip: Output gain before the limiter. Double-click resets.

items.name: Ceiling
items.tip: Limiter ceiling. Double-click resets.

items.name: Window 100 %
items.tip: Window size. Drag any edge or corner of the plugin to resize it; the shape stays the same. Double-click here for 100 %.

items.name: Resize
items.tip: Drag to resize the window. Every edge and corner works, and the shape stays the same.
